content: Hi, I'm Maya. I'm new to the loyalty card. How do I earn points?
Hi Maya. You earn 2 points for every $1 you spend. Show your card at the till and the points are added.
Nice. What can I get with the points?
A coffee costs 50 points, a pastry costs 80 points and a lunch combo costs 100 points.
I spent $12 yesterday. How many points is that?
$12 at 2 points per dollar is 24 points, so you are on your way to a free coffee.
Your points stay on the card while you keep using it. The shop staff can tell you more at the till.
OK. What time do you open on Saturday?
On Saturday we are open from 8am to 4pm.
On Sunday we are open from 9am to 1pm.
